name: liquid-domain-liquid-line-cannot-connect-to-thermofluid-line
source:
LiquidPipe LP(fluid$=Water, L=1, D=0.01, rough=0.0)
Pipe FP(fluid$=Water, L=1, D=0.01, rough=0.0)
connect(LP.out, FP.in)

error.message: connect(lp.out, fp.in): cannot connect a 'liquid' line (lp.out) to a 'fluid' line (fp.in). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
